summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 05/SM/2025 (Suo-Motu)** **Coram: Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu. V, Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri. Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** **Date of Order: 11.04.2025** IN THE MATTER OF # **Extension of Order dated 02.08.2024 in Petition No. 5/SM/2024** # **ORDER** The Commission has issued the levellised generic tariff for renewable energy technologies for the first year of the control period i.e. from 01.07.2024 to 31.03.2025 under Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024 vide Order dated 02.08.2024 in Petition No. 5/SM/2024. 2. The Commission has initiated the process of determination of levellised generic tariff for renewable energy technologies for the second year of the control period, i.e., FY 2025-26. The RE Tariff Order for FY 2025-26 will be issued after completing the due regulatory process procedures, which will take some more time. 3. In view of the above, the Order dated 02.08.2024 in Petition No. 5/SM/2024 shall continue to be in force till 30 th June 2025 or until further Orders, whichever is earlier. 4. Petition No. 05/SM/2025 is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/Sd/Sd/Sd/- **Ravinder Singh Dhillon Harish Dudani Ramesh Babu. V Jishnu Barua Member Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 05/SM/2025 CERC Website S. No. 326/2025 _Page_ **_1_** _of_ **_1_**
title: Extension of Order dated 02.08.2024 in Petition No. 5/SM/2024
